messages:
Maria: Quick sync — we need to lock MVP cut criteria before Wednesday. Acme pilot needs a deterministic acceptance set or they'll push for v1 parity. Thoughts?
Devin: Can we list features that must be in MVP vs deferred? My ask: embeddings cache + tenant SSO are high cost to bake now.
Sam: +1. Suggest baseline: core text generation, prompt routing, basic telemetry, rollout policy. Advanced SSO and tenant analytics = v1.
Irene: From design: shipping a bland SSO flow will hurt adoption. If Acme requires SSO for pilot, we should negotiate pilot waiver or add a lightweight OAuth flow.
Karan: Legal flagged "contractual uptime for pilot" — we shouldn't promise SLA. Offer "pilot support" with best-effort ops.
Maria: Good — propose concrete cut criteria doc: must-have, important, optional. I'll mock quick list.
Maria: ```
MUST: hosted API, model pinning, basic telemetry (latency+errors), prefix cache, per-route quotas
SHOULD: simple OAuth SSO, embeddings store with encryption at rest
COULD: advanced per-tenant dashboards, long-retention logs, A/B rollout
``` 
Devin: For performance SLOs, can we commit to 99th percentile latency < 250ms for 512 tokens on dedicated? Pilot probably ok with relaxed numbers.
Sam: Let's avoid numeric SLAs for hosted until internal perf tests pass. For pilot, say "target 99p < 350ms" and include fallback plan.
Irene: Acceptance criteria for UX: SSO basic flow + sign-in success > 95% in test harness, onboarding doc ready.
Karan: Ops: include rollback plan and canary window. If latency > threshold for >10% requests in 30m -> auto-fallback to smaller model.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary window 2026-05-12T18:00Z, notify #eng-oncall
Maria: Can we have engineering run a perf sweep Tues and surface results? If green we'll finalize MVP list and inform Acme.
Devin: Yep — will run perf + smoke on Mon/Tue. I'll post results here.
Sam: Once results are in, Maria, you'll send the updated cutlist and we'll sign off by Wed EOD.
Maria: OK — action items: Devin run perf; Irene make SSO minimal flow prototype; Karan draft pilot support language; Sam prepare comms to Acme.
Irene: I'll try to have prototype screenshots by Tues noon.
Karan: Draft to legal by EOD today.
Sam: Noted. :thumbsup:
Maria: Closing loop — aim to freeze MVP scope Wed 17:00 PT. If anything blocks, ping me directly.
